name: get_portfolio_summary
description: Retrieves high-level portfolio overview including total USD value, Net Greeks (Delta, Vega, Gamma), and portfolio Sharpe and Treynor ratios.

name: get_single_deal_risk
description: Retrieves quantitative risk metrics for an individual asset position: Beta (against Bitcoin), Delta, Volatility, Standard Deviation, Sharpe ratio (Rf=0), and Treynor ratio (Rf=0).

asset_id.description: The asset symbol or ID (e.g. ETH, SOL, ONDO_USDY).

name: get_covariance_correlations
description: Retrieves pairwise covariance and correlation metrics for the portfolio to identify concentration risks and high-correlation asset clusters.

name: get_tail_risk_report
description: Calculates 1-day 95% and 99% Value at Risk (VaR) and Expected Shortfall (CVaR) in USD for the current portfolio.

name: propose_rebalance_plan
description: Generates a proposed rebalancing plan to reduce portfolio risk or hedge net Delta/Vega. Important: The copilot can only propose, NEVER execute transactions.
